images.caption: Tean: deceptive lighthouse view This picture represents something of an illusion, for the lighthouse is not where it appears to be. The island is Tean but the lighthouse is on Round Island, about a kilometre to the north. This is viewed from the ferry to Penzance, which returned to the mainland around the north of St. Mary's.
